principle: Report valid completion, verdict correctness, cost, stability and repair separately; never collapse infrastructure failures into task failures or exclude them from the denominator without a preregistered rule.

metrics.definition: Independent oracle confirms the task checkpoint and required postcondition.
metrics.denominator: all admitted runs in the cell
metrics.censoring: infrastructure and provider failures remain in denominator and are separately categorized

metrics.definition: valid_completion AND verdict_correct for the same run.
Emitted clean/fault verdict agrees with the blinded independent gold verdict.
metrics.denominator: runs with a scorable gold verdict
metrics.censoring: not-emitted is incorrect for end-to-end analysis and separately reported

metrics.definition: Clean runs incorrectly reported as fault.
metrics.numerator: clean ground truth with emitted fault
metrics.censoring: not-emitted is reported separately and included in sensitivity analysis

metrics.definition: Fault runs incorrectly reported as clean or not detected.
metrics.numerator: fault ground truth with emitted clean/not-emitted
metrics.censoring: infrastructure failures are separate but not silently removed

metrics.definition: After a predeclared UI evolution, the test artifact is repaired and passes the same independent oracle on all required replays.
metrics.numerator: evolution cells with successful repair and replays
metrics.censoring: timeout and unresolved repair are right-censored with reason

metrics.definition: Active person-minutes from repair start to validated replay success or censoring.
metrics.censoring: censored observations retained for survival/two-part analysis

metrics.definition: Number of changed lines or normalized edit units in the test artifact, with file count reported separately.
Pass rate across repeated runs of the same task-condition-arm-model cell.
Elapsed time from runner start to terminal result, including provider waits and browser actions.
metrics.censoring: timeouts reported at timeout boundary plus censoring flag

metrics.definition: Number of executed browser actions; rejected provider decisions are reported separately as retries/errors.
Provider or runner retry attempts divided by decision/action opportunities.
metrics.censoring: infrastructure retry policy frozen before confirmatory runs

metrics.definition: Provider token usage and billed API cost, reported separately when provider exposes both.
metrics.censoring: null when provider does not expose reliable usage; never imputed as zero

metrics.definition: Distribution of perception, grounding, planning, execution, oracle, environment and task-defect outcomes.
metrics.censoring: mutually exclusive primary category plus optional subcategory

metrics.definition: Time spent by the independent evaluator after agent termination.

aggregation_rules: Primary effectiveness metrics are reported per task-condition-arm-model cell before any macro aggregation.
Macro averages weight tasks equally; micro averages are supplementary and expose denominator sensitivity.
Application and task are modeled as random effects where the number of admitted tasks permits.
Pairwise arm contrasts use matched task-condition blocks and report effect size with confidence intervals, not only p-values.
Arm-by-condition and arm-by-model interactions are prespecified moderators; no post-hoc winner selection is allowed.
